Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): creative, adventure, hardcore or game-type path; the game is survival at the pinned difficulty. Formerly listed as missing: the packet send at login (ServerConfigurationManager.java:145) and EntityPlayerMP's respawn resend (EntityPlayerMP.java:1047): no native counterpart; the replay client's capabilities come from the snapshot and never change handlePlayerAbilities (NetHandlerPlayClient.java:1521): the native client never applies an abilities packet
